subject: Startups
title: Patents in Startups
description: A quick win: understand Patents in Startups.

hook.text: A patent costs $15,000–$30,000 and takes 2–4 years to grant.

buildup.text: Patents protect novel inventions for 20 years.

discovery.text: In biotech and hardware, patents are essential. In software, speed to market often matters more than legal protection.

twist.text: Patent trolls buy cheap patents and sue startups that can't afford to fight.

climax.text: File provisional patents to establish priority cheaply—about $2,000.

punchline.text: Patents matter in some industries. Speed matters in all of them.

quiz.question: What is a provisional patent?
options: A cheap way to establish priority for up to one year
